biography_text: 暴雨压城，万顷洪流将七军阵势与山川一并吞没。关羽踏入怒涛，双手沉握青龙偃月刀，将奔腾不息的传承之力尽数压入刀锋。一刀落下，洪水自脚前裂向天际，巨浪向两侧拔起如万仞城壁，沉睡水底的岩脊、淤沙与旧时残木尽皆显露。刀光尚未散去，水墙之巅的战船已小如芥子。关羽压刀收势，长髯迎风，独立于乍现的海底长廊；江海为之一静，远方城门尽在锋芒所指。
fiction_note: 游戏幻想演绎，借“水淹七军”的历史意象创作；一刀分水、露出海底及传承神力均属虚构，并非史实。

prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE finished premium fantasy Three Kingdoms game biography illustration, landscape exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels, no text, no frame.
Primary request: Guan Yu has just cleaved an immense body of floodwater completely apart with ONE overwhelming guandao strike, exposing the seabed beneath. This is a fantastical reinterpretation of Water Floods Seven Armies, not a historical reconstruction. The single blade strike, the divided waters and the immense revealed bottom must tell the story instantly.
Input image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY AND RENDERING reference ONLY. Keep exactly this mature Chinese warrior's recognizable red-tan face, stern brows, long flowing black beard, emerald green headdress with gold crown detail, rich emerald robe with white lining, ornate gold dragon shoulder armor, and dragon-decorated long guandao. Do NOT reproduce the reference pose, throne, composition, hand gesture, dragon or ships.
Composition: extraordinarily deep cinematic 3:2 wide perspective, camera low on the newly exposed seabed. An enormous V-shaped passage splits the water from foreground to a distant vanishing point. Two absolutely colossal translucent dark-teal walls of suspended water tower on either side, many times Guan Yu's height, rising almost out of the image with curling foamy crests. The freshly exposed broad rocky silt seabed fills the lower third and continues very far into the passage, with wet rock strata, rippled sand, glistening shallow rivulets and scattered small stones. This is parted WATER, not a narrow canyon or stone cliff.
Guan Yu is the only prominent human, near the foreground left-of-center, FULL BODY about 28 percent of image height, so we can recognize his face and costume but he is dwarfed by the enormous waterwalls. His stance is a powerful low twisting lunge, one leg planted forward, both hands gripping the same long unbroken guandao shaft. Show the exact instant AFTER a devastating diagonal downward cleaving stroke: hips and torso rotated, green robe and beard streaming back, blade low and forward in unmistakable dynamic follow-through, head in clear three-quarter profile, face visible. The weapon has a long shaft and ONE broad recognizable crescent blade, not a sword. A restrained razor-thin emerald-white arc traces the single slash from the raised mist overhead down to the blade and continues as a long vanishing incision along the exposed seabed. Water is thrown away from the cut, never a solid beam obscuring the scene.
Scale: tiny distant wooden warships held high at the top surfaces of the waterwalls, almost specks, emphasize immense scale; distant besieged fortress towers are tiny against the horizon beyond the gap. The huge water walls show believable depth, weight, suspended turbulent currents, clear translucent inner edges, falling droplets, vertical streaks of spray and white foam. The cut is supernatural, the water rendering convincing and physically rich. No giant dragon stealing the narrative.
Lighting: storm clouds open narrowly above the far end of the corridor; dramatic silver shafts catch the spray and gold armor; jewel teal and jade water, deep blue shadows, warm natural wet rock. Monumental, tense, triumphant, awe-inspiring. Match the reference's refined high-detail Chinese epic fantasy painting, crisp craftsmanship, realistic material separation.
Constraints: completely new action and composition; no seated or static command pose; no open-palm magic gesture; no card UI, borders, typography, letters, watermark, collage; no red-haired or white-haired warrior; no other foreground heroes; no impossible extra limbs or broken weapon; no excessive bloom or gold confetti. Deliver the finished landscape image.
